title: Kramer Baretta, Custom Graphics, Time Machine, Exclusive

long_description.title: A Double Cutaway Classic, Now in An Exclusive "Time Machine" Graphic Finish
long_description.body: Buckle up and get ready to hit 88 miles per hour and beyond—the Kramer Baretta with exclusive "Time Machine" graphic finish is taking you back to the era of killer tone and style! The Baretta is a tribute to one of the most iconic and original guitar designs in rock. Features an alder body, satin-finished hard maple neck, a single Kramer 85-T black and cream zebra-coil humbucker™, and a Floyd Rose® 1000 series tremolo with an R2 1000 series locking nut. It is finished with a "Time Machine" graphic finish, a Kramer exclusive. A premium gig bag is also included.

Electronics Specs.Bridge Pickup: Kramer 85-T Humbucker Black Cream Zebra Coils
Electronics Specs.Controls: 1 Volume, Push/Pull Potentiometer for Series/Parallel Tap

Misc Specs.Accessories: Allen Wrench Holder - Back of Headstock
